headline: Qualcomm-affiliated authors publish RFChipAgent for LNA topology selection, schematic assembly and verification
fact: Awani Khodkumbhe and Qualcomm-affiliated coauthors publish RFChipAgent, a human-supervised LLM-agent flow for analog/RF design. It connects document retrieval, topology selection, schematic and testbench assembly, simulation-guided optimization, and operating-point and stability checks. The reported case is a GF22FDSOI 60 GHz wideband LNA. The paper is a preprint submitted for possible publication, not a product release, measured-silicon result or evidence of company-wide adoption. Khodkumbhe also lists UC Berkeley affiliation.
